protocol503a.title: HRP-503a Survey Research Protocol template
protocol503a.note: For surveys, questionnaires, interviews, and focus groups (.docx).

existingData.title: Existing Data Protocol template
existingData.note: For secondary analysis of data that was already collected (.doc).

consentSbe.title: HRP-502 Social/Behavioral Informed Consent template
consentSbe.note: The social/behavioral consent form — not the biomedical version (.docx).

infoSheet.title: Information Sheet for Studies Without Consent
infoSheet.note: For anonymous/online studies where documentation of consent is waived (.docx).

parentPermission.title: HRP-502p Parent Permission template
parentPermission.note: Parent/guardian permission — required when participants are minors (.docx).

assent.title: HRP-502a Assent template
assent.note: The child assent form minors sign alongside parent permission (.docx).

determination.title: Human Subjects Research Determination Form
determination.note: File this to get an official "not human subjects research" letter (.doc).

exemptTool.title: Exempt Assessment Tool & Protocol Builder
exemptTool.note: Walks you through whether an exempt category fits your study (.docx).

training.title: CITI "Basic Social & Behavioral Research" training
training.note: Required for everyone listed on the protocol, including students. Do this before you submit.

portal.title: Submit in the IRB Protocol Management system
portal.note: VT login required — every submission goes through this portal.

contact.title: HRPP office — questions & consultations
contact.note: irb@vt.edu · 540-231-3732 · virtual office hours are listed on the HRPP site.

ferpa.title: Forms & Guidance (FERPA, SOPs, checklists)
ferpa.note: Using VT student education records usually needs Registrar permission and may need consent.

policy.title: VT Policy 13040 — Human Subjects Research
policy.note: Full-board submission deadlines tie to the monthly meeting schedule.
